history.alt_text: Massive steel industrial molds staged on concrete in a factory yard under low sunlight.
history.caption: The entire cost of a supplied tool and its freight becomes a dutiable asset spread over the imported units it produces.
history.title: Dutiable Tooling Assists

style_when: scale is the story — a port, a refinery, a data centre hall, a rail yard, a skyline of cranes — and the reader needs to feel how big it is
prompt: A 200mm telephoto long-lens view of massive, heavy industrial steel injection molds and die tooling staged on concrete in a factory loading bay. Off-centre asymmetrical composition. Stacked overlapping layers of industrial structure with crystal-clear telephoto distance clarity and flat compressed perspective. Deep industrial contrast with weathered orange, slate grey, and raw steel tones. Dramatic, low-raking golden-hour sunlight from the left casting deep, long shadows across the textured concrete. Crisp atmospheric clarity, no people in the foreground, no text, no fog.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, typography, watermarks, signatures, people, faces
rationale: The story is about the immense financial weight of capital equipment (tooling/molds) sitting at a supplier's plant. A telephoto long-lens view of heavy industrial molds emphasizes their physical and financial scale within the manufacturing supply chain.
cue: The tooling you hand a supplier is a dutiable assist
subject: massive steel industrial molds staged in a factory yard
core_thesis: Customs bills the value of supplied tooling and its freight across the units it produces, making the tool a dutiable assist.
core_conflict: Generalized company-wide tooling cost amortization versus strict line-by-line customs valuation.
composition: off-centre asymmetry with extreme telephoto compression

title: Duties On Supplied Tooling
